age.evidence: Adult Sprague Dawley rats ( n = 12, 6 male, 6 female, weight 300 -350 g, Charles River Laboratories Inc., Wilmington, MA)

sex.evidence: Adult Sprague Dawley rats ( n = 12, 6 male, 6 female, weight 300 -350 g ...)

dosing.evidence: Each rat ( n = 12, 6 male, 6 female) received 0.9% saline and three doses of psilocybin (0.1, 1, and 10 mg/kg) as a continuous infusion over the course of an hour. Each infusion session was separated by 5 -7 days and was conducted in a random order.

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on 12 h: 12 h light: dark cycle (lights ON at 8:00 am) ... rats were connected to the EEG acquisition system between 9:00 and 9:30am

assays.assay_description: Video-recorded HTR in EEG recording chamber (tethered rat with jugular catheter), counted by blinded visual analysis for 5 min before and throughout a 60-min continuous i.v. infusion of saline or psilocybin (0.1, 1, 10 mg/kg); counts binned in 5-min epochs and summed over 60 min. Within-subject design, 4 sessions separated by 5-7 days.

application_type.evidence: one of the three doses of psilocybin (0.1, 1, or 10 mg/kg) was delivered (intravenous) over an hour

setup_habituation.evidence: All rats were allowed at least 7 -10 days of post-surgical recovery, during which they were conditioned to the recording chambers and EEG acquisition system.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were tethered to the EEG acquisition system; no restraint described and HTR/locomotion were freely expressed ("Rat activity and locomotion were captured using a 3-axis gyroscope sensor").

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the recording chamber; home-cage food ad libitum ('with ad libitum food and water').

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the recording chamber; home-cage water ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: The HTR was quantified ... for the 5-min period prior to the start of intravenous infusion of either saline or psilocybin, and for the entirety of 60-min infusion period.

sample_size.evidence: n = 12, 6 male and 6 female rats for all treatment groups except for 10 mg/kg group which had 5 male rats

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin dose-dependently induced HTR with an inverted U-shaped dose-effect curve over the infusion; 10 mg/kg produced more twitches early (0-10 min), 1 mg/kg peaked at 5-15 min. Total 60-min HTR count was significantly increased by 1 and 10 mg/kg but not 0.1 mg/kg versus saline.
outcomes.statistics: 0-5 min: 10 mg/kg vs saline, 0.1, 1 mg/kg all p ≤ 0.0001; 5-10 min: 10 mg/kg vs saline p ≤ 0.0001, vs 0.1 p ≤ 0.0001, vs 1 mg/kg p = 0.0028; 1 mg/kg vs saline p = 0.0004, vs 0.1 p = 0.0097; 10-15 min: 1 mg/kg vs saline p ≤ 0.0001, vs 0.1 p = 0.0046, vs 10 mg/kg p ≤ 0.0001; total HTR: 1 mg/kg p = 0.0362, 10 mg/kg p = 0.0308 (Tukey post-hoc, linear mixed model)
outcomes.evidence: Analysis of the total number of headtwitches recorded throughout the entire 60-min infusion (Fig. 2B) revealed that as compared to saline infusion, infusion of both 1 mg/kg ( p = 0.0362) and 10 mg/kg (p = 0.0308) psilocybin produced significant increases in head-twitches.

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR counts were either binned in 5-min epochs or summed for the entire 60-min infusion. (single variable: HTR count)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR count data are presented as group means ± standard error of the means in 5-min bins.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions, sequences or bout structure reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded as an ethological behaviour by the rubric.

B5_social.evidence: No social component; rats tested individually.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The HTR was quantified using visual analysis of video recordings

B8_multivariate.evidence: Linear mixed models with dose and time as fixed factors; no multivariate behavioural analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: they were conditioned to the recording chambers and EEG acquisition system

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat individually tethered to the EEG acquisition system in a recording chamber; no conspecific described.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each infusion session (0.9% saline or one of three psilocybin doses) was performed on a separate day with an interval of 5 -7 days between sessions.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The HTR was quantified ... for the 5-min period prior to the start of intravenous infusion ... and for the entirety of 60-min infusion period (contiguous 65-min scored bout).

D3_recording_days.evidence: All rats received, on separate days, each of the three doses of psilocybin and vehicle control (4 recording days).

D4_baseline.evidence: The HTR was quantified using visual analysis of video recordings for the 5-min period prior to the start of intravenous infusion

D5_followup.evidence: HTR scored only during the acute infusion window; no recording ≥24 h after drug as follow-up.

D6_circadian.evidence: Scored bout ~65 min, far below 6 h.

assays.assay_description: Rat activity/movement measured as mean 3D angular velocity from a 3-axis gyroscope built into the EEG head-stage, binned in 10-min epochs across baseline, 60-min i.v. infusion (saline, 0.1, 1, 10 mg/kg psilocybin) and post-infusion period in the EEG recording chamber; 4 sessions per rat on separate days.

application_type.evidence: one of the three doses of psilocybin (0.1, 1, or 10 mg/kg) was delivered (intravenous) over an hour

setup_habituation.evidence: All rats were allowed at least 7 -10 days of post-surgical recovery, during which they were conditioned to the recording chambers and EEG acquisition system.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rat activity and locomotion were captured using a 3-axis gyroscope sensor built into the EEG acquisition head-stage (tethered, freely moving; no restraint described).

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the recording chamber; home-cage food ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the recording chamber; home-cage water ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: Analysis of the mean 3D angular velocity throughout the recording session ... (gyroscope recorded continuously from before infusion onset).

sample_size.evidence: n = 12, 6 male and 6 female rats for all treatment groups except for 10 mg/kg group which had 5 male rats (Fig. 2 caption; gyroscope-specific n not separately stated)

outcomes.summary: 0.1 mg/kg psilocybin had no effect on movement; 1 mg/kg briefly (~10 min) increased movement after 10 min of infusion; 10 mg/kg decreased movement at 30-50 min and at 70 min, producing a quiescent state (inverted-U relationship with dose).
outcomes.statistics: 0.1 mg/kg vs saline p > 0.05; 1 mg/kg vs saline p = 0.0069; 10 mg/kg vs saline all p ≤ 0.023 (FDR-corrected post-hoc, linear mixed model)
outcomes.evidence: The 1 mg/kg dose induced a brief period (~10 min) of increased movements after 10 min of infusion ( p = 0.0069)... The 10 mg/kg psilocybin produced a significant decrease in rat movements 30 -50 min and at 70 min in the infusion period (all p ≤ 0.023).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Analysis of the mean 3D angular velocity throughout the recording session

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The gyroscope data were binned in 10-min epochs.

B4_ethological.evidence: General movement/angular velocity only; locomotor measures not ethological per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Rat activity and locomotion were captured using a 3-axis gyroscope sensor (motion signal, no behavioural classification).

E1_environment_type.evidence: they were conditioned to the recording chambers and EEG acquisition system

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat individually tethered to the EEG acquisition system; no conspecific described.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each infusion session ... was performed on a separate day with an interval of 5 -7 days between sessions.

D2_session_duration.evidence: We focused our analysis on 90 min of EEG data comprising a 10-min pre-psilocybin infusion baseline period, 60 min ... and 20 min immediately after the end of ... infusion; gyroscope effects reported 'at 70 min in the infusion period'.

D3_recording_days.evidence: All rats received, on separate days, each of the three doses of psilocybin and vehicle control (4 recording days).

D4_baseline.evidence: 90 min of data comprising a 10-min pre-psilocybin infusion baseline period; mean 3D angular velocity analysed 'throughout the recording session'.

D5_followup.evidence: No recording ≥24 h after drug as follow-up.

judge_notes: Kept HTR and gyroscope locomotion as two separate assays (2 of 3 candidates); they measure different behavioural domains with different methods (video scoring vs head-stage gyroscope). EEG/PAC/wPLI analyses excluded as neural recordings.
B1 overridden to 0 for both assays: HTR binned vs summed is the same single variable (HTR count); locomotion is a single variable (mean 3D angular velocity).
D2 set to 2 for HTR (contiguous 5-min pre-infusion + 60-min infusion = 65 min scored bout) and locomotion (90-min analysed window incl. post-infusion, effect reported at 70 min).
D3 set to 1 (4 recording days = 2-7 category); gemma's score of 2 was inconsistent with its own category.
n_per_group_min set to 11 (10 mg/kg group missing one male session) rather than candidates' 5, which reflected male count only.
time_dependent set to n/a per rubric (single time_to_assay; within-session bins are not distinct timepoints). sex_dependent 'no': sex included as fixed factor with no main effect.
setup_habituation 'yes': rats were conditioned to the recording chambers during recovery and habituated ≥1 h before baseline.
Dosing schedule 'repeated' (modal): each rat received three psilocybin doses across sessions 5-7 days apart in a within-subject design.
